newsitem.title: USA: Clinicor Inc sees $0.15 shr loss in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Clinicor Inc sees $0.15 shr loss in Q1.

text.p: Clinicor Inc said Tuesday that it is expecting a loss of $600,000, or $0.15 per share in the first quarter, ended March 31.

The company said the loss, which compares with a loss of $0.02 per share in the year-earlier period, is largely due ot increased, sellingm, general and administrative expenses related to the expanison of its staff and infrastructure, its support of a growing backlog, and its sales and marketing efforts. The company said that these expenses more than offset a modest increase in gross profit mnargins.
Revenues, said Clinicor, are expected to increase to about $2.5 million, from $855,000.

In other news, the company said that it has named Jim Clark, chief financial officer. Clark previously worked at as CFO for Bay Resources Inc, a privately-held Florida-based computer leasing and consulting firm.
The company could not be immediately reached for further comment.
Clinicor also said that it is currently seeking additional equity capital and bank financing to fund its growing base of contract activity and increased sales and marketing efforts.

The company said that it has withdrawn its November 1996 application for listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market and that it intends to re-apply for listing on the SmallCap Market following completion of the proposed financing.

Clinicor is a contract research organization, that provides Phase I through Phase IV clinical trials management, including patient recruitment, monitoring, data management services and regulatory consultation, to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device industries.
